name_story.story: Fatuma can be understood through the Arabic form فَاطِمَة, whose central sense is fatuma; fatima (east african form). Fatuma is the East African form of Arabic فَاطِمَة (Fāṭima), the name of the Prophet's daughter.

faq.a: Fatuma is associated with the Arabic form فَاطِمَة, whose core sense is fatuma; fatima (east african form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Fatuma?
faq.a: Fatuma is associated with Arabic. Fatuma is the East African form of Arabic فَاطِمَة (Fāṭima), the name of the Prophet's daughter.
Yes — the underlying form فَاطِمَة is Arabic.
Fatuma can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Fatuma should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Fāṭima is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Fatuma mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Fatuma is rendered فاطمہ and carries the sense فاطمہ، نبی کی بیٹی.

faq.q: What does Fatuma mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Fatuma is rendered فاطمه and carries the sense فاطمه، دختر پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is fa-tu-ma. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Fatuma?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Fatuma, fatuma. Script forms are فاطمه, فاطمہ, فَاطِمَة, फ़ातुमा.

faq.q: Is Fatuma a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
